steps.name: update-ci-esp-idf-to-v5-5-4
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=19999bde451f068ee503d4b7c9a0a91712709c2a; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml'); s=p.read_text(); assert s.count('ESP-IDF 5.5.1') == 1; assert s.count('esp_idf_version: v5.5.1') == 1; s=s.replace('ESP-IDF 5.5.1','ESP-IDF 5.5.4').replace('esp_idf_version: v5.5.1','esp_idf_version: v5.5.4'); p.write_text(s)"; grep -F 'Build ESP32-S3 firmware with ESP-IDF 5.5.4' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -F 'esp_idf_version: v5.5.4' .github/workflows/ci.yml; if grep -Fq '5.5.1' .github/workflows/ci.yml; then exit 1; fi; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-ci-yaml-check
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --files .github/workflows/ci.yml; .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; s=Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text(); assert s.count('esp_idf_version: v5.5.4') == 1; assert 'v5.5.1' not in s"; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-ci-v5-5-4
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true; export PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'; rm -rf build/idf-gate; bash scripts/idf_gate_build.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Use ESP-IDF v5.5.4 in CI'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
